title: A Novel Preoperative Prediction Model Based on Deep Learning to Predict Neoplasm T Staging and Grading in Patients with Upper Tract Urothelial Carcinoma.
summary: Deep-learning models predicted pathological T stage and grade from preoperative data in 884 upper-tract urothelial carcinoma patients. A random 80/20 patient split assessed selected CNN-BiGRU/BiGRU models; AUCs ranged 0.760–0.824 across endpoints. This is a retrospective single-center diagnostic-prediction result.
ai_technology: Five deep-learning architectures compared; XGBoost screening and clinical feature selection preceded model fitting. Random train/test split 80/20; 884 pathologically confirmed patients. Best T-stage CNN-BiGRU AUC 0.760; grade AUC 0.804 (1973 WHO) and 0.824 (2004 WHO).
